Locations.Text: SVE adds places that widen the valley beyond the original town.

BlueMoonVineyard.Name: Blue Moon Vineyard
BlueMoonVineyard.Description: Sophia's vineyard home, with grape work, kegs, sewing, and quiet grief.

CindersapForest.Name: Cindersap Forest
CindersapForest.Description: The forest expands with Fairhaven Farm, Aurora Vineyard, West Cindersap, and more magical routes.

FairhavenFarm.Name: Fairhaven Farm
FairhavenFarm.Description: Andy's isolated Cindersap farm, marked by stubborn independence and loneliness.

AuroraVineyard.Name: Aurora Vineyard
AuroraVineyard.Description: An abandoned, magical vineyard tied to Junimos and Apples.

Grampleton.Name: Grampleton
Grampleton.Description: A larger neighboring region east of town, beyond everyday Pelican Town routines.

Highlands.Name: Highlands
Highlands.Description: A remote, dangerous adventure region tied to Lance and late-game exploration.

Villagers.Text: These residents belong to the SVE version of the valley.

Alesia.Name: Alesia
Alesia.Description: A seasoned Castle Village adventurer tied to the wider dangerous world.

Andy.Name: Andy
Andy.Description: A lonely Fairhaven farmer, stubborn, Joja-leaning, and often at the saloon.

Apples.Name: Apples
Apples.Description: A Junimo tied to Aurora Vineyard and gentle forest magic.

Camilla.Name: Camilla
Camilla.Description: A powerful witch whose concerns reach beyond ordinary Pelican Town routines.

Claire.Name: Claire
Claire.Description: A reserved commuter cashier with dreams beyond retail, fond of books, dance, films, and birds.

Gunther.Name: Gunther
Gunther.Description: The museum curator as an active resident, scholarly and patient.

Hank.Name: Hank
Hank.Description: A side resident in the expanded town social web; use cautiously unless context adds detail.

Henchman.Name: Henchman
Henchman.Description: A guarded figure around the Witch's Swamp and magical boundaries.

Isaac.Name: Isaac
Isaac.Description: A hardened adventurer from the dangerous world beyond the valley.

Jadu.Name: Jadu
Jadu.Description: A magical outsider connected to SVE's broader world.

Jolyne.Name: Jolyne
Jolyne.Description: A Castle Village figure from the broader adventuring network.

Lance.Name: Lance
Lance.Description: A disciplined adventurer and marriage candidate tied to distant expeditions.

Marlon.Name: Marlon
Marlon.Description: The Adventurer's Guild leader, scarred, practical, and tied to the valley's dangers.

Martin.Name: Martin
Martin.Description: A polite countryside teen employee who visits town for work and library books.

Morgan.Name: Morgan
Morgan.Description: A young magic student connected to the Wizard, curious and still learning.

Morris.Name: Morris
Morris.Description: JojaMart's ambitious manager, corporate and image-conscious.

Olivia.Name: Olivia
Olivia.Description: A wealthy retiree and Victor's mother, fond of wine, food, painting, yoga, and status.

Peaches.Name: Peaches
Peaches.Description: A minor magical-side character; mention only when context makes it natural.

Scarlett.Name: Scarlett
Scarlett.Description: Sophia's close friend and a steady emotional support in her life.

Sophia.Name: Sophia
Sophia.Description: The shy Blue Moon Vineyard owner, fond of anime, manga, cosplay, sewing, and quiet routines.

Susan.Name: Susan
Susan.Description: An Emerald Farm resident with a practical farming perspective.

Treyvon.Name: Treyvon
Treyvon.Description: A side character in the expanded world; keep references context-led.

Victor.Name: Victor
Victor.Description: Olivia's thoughtful engineer son, educated and uncertain about his future.
